system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
The objects on the scale make it balance exactly. On the left pan there is a 1 kg weight (mass) and half a brick. On the right pan there is one brick.

[Image: A balance scale with objects on each pan]

What is the weight (mass) of one brick?

Figure, described in words:
A two-pan balance scale is shown balanced horizontally on a central pivot and base. On the left pan, there is a weight labeled "1 kg" shaped like a standard counterweight, and a standing rectangular block representing half a brick. On the right pan, there is a larger rectangular block representing one whole brick, which has the same height as the block on the left pan but twice its width.

A. 0.5 kg
B. 1 kg
C. 2 kg
D. 3 kg

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
